descriptions.baseUrl: API origin, no trailing slash and no /api. Local: http://localhost:5000. Any other host in the collection is a bug.
descriptions.accessToken: Access token (15 min). Written automatically by the Login request's test script.
descriptions.productId: Mongo ObjectId of the product under test. Written by the product-create request.
descriptions.orderId: Order ObjectId. Written by the create-order request.
descriptions.orderNumber: Human-readable order number (IP-...). Written by the create-order request.
descriptions.razorpayOrderId: Razorpay order id (order_...). Written by POST /api/payments/razorpay/create.
descriptions.razorpayPaymentId: Razorpay payment id (pay_...) from Razorpay Checkout, or from a test payment in the dashboard.
descriptions.razorpaySignature: razorpay_signature returned by Checkout in the browser. Needed only by the verify request.
descriptions.razorpayWebhookSecret: Webhook secret for this endpoint (Razorpay dashboard, Settings -> Webhooks). The pre-request script signs the raw body with it. SECRET: never commit a real value.
